_comment: Per-model per-1M-token pricing for quoin benchmark harness. Claude-only. Codex models NOT included (no public per-token pricing; would constitute token inference per quoin/adapters/codex/cost.md). The benchmark pins claude-opus-5-5 with the sonnet and haiku 5.5 models behind the aliases; the 4.7 and 4.6 entries stay so older runs can be re-read. Update at benchmark time by verifying against current Anthropic pricing page.
_note: Starting with the 4.6 generation, every Claude model ID is a pinned snapshot including the dateless form (see Anthropic's docs above) — there is no separate dated snapshot to discover for these models. Keys here are therefore the bare model IDs, matching the CLI's `canonicalModel` field exactly. Cache write is the 5-minute rate. claude-haiku-5-5 carries a long_prompt_tier for prompts over 100,000 tokens; table estimates use the base rates only (a lower bound), runtime-reported cost is authoritative.
_authoritative_source: quoin/scripts/cost_from_jsonl.py's PRICES table is the authoritative Claude pricing source for quoin's cost tooling. This file is a deliberately narrower copy covering only the models the benchmark suite pins, kept so the harness reads as a standalone artifact. Every rate here must match PRICES for the same model; a test enforces that. When a shared model's price changes, update both.
